name: The Laguna
insider_take: The Laguna isn't just a beachfront escape—it's Bali's original luxury resort pioneer, sitting on sacred ground where ancient Balinese ceremonies still take place on its pristine shoreline.
whats_special: This iconic Luxury Collection property features seven cascading lagoon pools that mirror traditional Balinese rice terraces, while its location in Nusa Dua places you in Bali's most exclusive enclave—originally designed as a masterplanned resort destination with manicured beaches and world-class golf courses.
pro_tip: Book a lagoon access room to step directly from your terrace into the interconnected pool system, and time your stay during the full moon when traditional Balinese blessing ceremonies illuminate the beach at sunset.
dont_miss: The nearby Bali Collection shopping complex for duty-free luxury goods, and the adjacent Bali National Golf Club—one of Asia's most challenging clifftop courses with dramatic ocean views from every hole.
pros: Prime beachfront location in prestigious Nusa Dua area
Extensive lagoon-style swimming pools with tropical landscaping
Spacious rooms and suites with traditional Balinese décor
Multiple dining options including beachfront restaurants
cons: Large resort property requiring walking or shuttle between facilities
Premium pricing typical of luxury beachfront resorts
